en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a French military parade entering a city. In the center, a high-ranking officer (Général Gouraud) rides a white horse, accompanied by other officers on foot and horseback, followed by troops in World War I-era French uniforms and helmets. They march along a street or bridge with tram tracks, lined by balustrades and multi‑story European buildings in the background. Printed caption text in French appears at the bottom, along with the publisher's credit and a date from 1918.
